title: Kissed Crunchy Brazilian Chicken Sandwich
description: A savory and crunchy Brazilian dish featuring parsley and double-rise-bread, perfect for a post-workout meal with anti-inflammatory benefits
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, turmeric, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken cutlets to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and coat with chopped parsley.
Place the coated chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the double-rise-bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the sandwiches by placing a cooked chicken cutlet on each toasted bread slice.
Top each chicken cutlet with crumbled brazilian cheese and serve immediately.
